$schema: AXIEONEX motion inventory — machine-readable. tokenRefs point at axieonex-tokens.json names.
principles: No element's readability may depend on an animation completing.
Every custom animation has a paired prefers-reduced-motion rule.
Route transitions share one timing source (the shared controller), not per-page durations.

globalRules.revealFallback: elements already in viewport on mount get their visible class immediately, never wait for scroll
